sections.text:
The type IM3X relay can be used as un retarded over current or under current relays for 
either 
protective or indicating duties. In conjunction with a separately mounted time-lag relay it can be used for over 
current protection with a fixed time-lag, by virtue of its low consumption, even 
when the capacity of the CT is limited

This procedure
details the steps required to completely check the proper operation and
calibration of the directional earth fault over current relay. It is recommended this procedure be carried out on an
annually bases. The document is formatted the way to minimize the possibility
of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment.

 Head Sector of Aswan Network.

Line isolation and work permit required

sections.text:
Steps to prepare for relay 
testing

Review technical reference material and 
manufacturer's manual

Obtain copy of relay setting from field 
maintenance file and compare it with the setting on the relay

Obtain outage for line protected by this 
relay

Check that the circuit breaker is opened and 
tagged

Inspect the CT secondary circuits, the VT 
miniature circuit breakers (MCB's) and all cabling supplying the relaying

Use the station drawings to isolate the 
following:
 * Breaker trip coils
 * Breaker failure scheme associated with the relay and 
disturbance alarms

sections.text:
Reading the setting from the relay by using 
the PC

items: By using the MMI (main machine interface) of the relay read the setting

Be sure that the DC power of the relay is correct by applying a DC voltmeter 
 across points 4 and 6 on the rear of the relay

Connect the current test leads between the current terminals on the rear of the current relay 
 1.2 of the (IM3X) first stage
Connect AC power to the test set
Inject current to the relay

Increase slowly the current until reach to the operating value and then the 
 red "LED's" light the operate current is shown on the display of the using 
 ammeter
Record this value (I operate) on the test sheet

Connect leads between the time delayed trip output contact terminal 13 and 14 on 
 the rely to the time terminals on the tester
Switch on the timer of the test set
The value of the trip time display on the test set
Record this value (t" operate) on the test sheet

Increase the current injection to 25% larger than the operating value (I 
 operate)

Slowly decrease the injection current until the relay reset tack the value of 
 this current (I reset)
Record this value (I reset) on the test sheet
Repeat steps from 2 to 13 to test phase R (2) second stage

sections.text:
Return relay and associated equipment to 
service

items:
Return relay to service by removing the test leads from the relay terminals 
 and the test set
Make sure CT and V T secondary circuits are in normal condition
Remove the disturbance alarm LED`s on the relay which is caused by the test
Request feeder to be returned in service

Take phasor readings of all A C currents and voltages and compare them to 
 those for normal load condition

Check that these reading agree with station meters (MW, Mvar, Amperes and power 
 factor)

Place a copy of the test result in 
 the field maintenance file
